## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), e.g. `feat(data): add Malaysia`.
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/open-energy-transition/Awesome-Electricity-Demand/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-off-your-commits-dco).
- [ ] The data files are valid and README.md is up to date (`uv run scripts/build.py readme`), or I've said that I couldn't run it.
- [ ] If AI tools were used, the description says which ones and for what.
